free_tier.stated: 50,000 records on the Free/Build plan (100K on the paid Grow tier); 10,000 search requests/month
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: Search requests are the meter, not bytes. 10,000 search requests/month is ~333/day. The most op-limited of the storage providers compared.

tooling: REST API, official SDKs for ~15 languages, `algolia` CLI, InstantSearch widgets; records are JSON only
chaining: 50K records x ~10 KB average = ~500 MB of usable payload per app. Several free apps would need several accounts. Record-size guidance is 'Avg 10KB/Record max 100KB', so the absolute ceiling is 50K x 100 KB = 5 GB, and that requires exceeding the size guidance.
limits_note: 50K records; 10K search requests/month; avg 10 KB/record, max 100 KB/record; JSON only (no binary. Base64 must be embedded in a string attribute and bloats the record); indexing operations are separately rate-limited.

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: Extremely reliable CDN-backed search, but it is a search index, not a store: records are tokenized and stored in an inverted index, so storing base64 blobs both inflates size ~33% and destroys index performance. Not usable as blob storage in practice.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.

evidence.proved: 'Free ... 50K records included'; '100K records included then $0.40 per additional 1K records' (Grow); '10K search requests/month'; 'Avg 10KB/Record max 100KB'
